note: Coverage ruler pin. The four digests under `pinned` must match at score time or the audit fails closed and quotes no ratio. `triples_*_at_pin_time` is RECORDED ONLY — the graph is the thing under measurement and is never pinned, so a genuine extraction change still scores at full sensitivity. RE-PINNING IS THE ESCAPE HATCH AND IT IS NOT SEALED: whoever re-pins can move the ruler and then quote a number. `supersedes` is why that cannot be silent — it carries the digests and row counts this pin replaced, so the pin's own diff shows the ruler change that licensed the new series. Same trust model as the assertion fixture: committed, diffed, reviewed.
